【原视频简介】
I Built a PC Inside a Keyboard!

What if your keyboard was actually a complete computer? That’s exactly what I wanted to find out by building my own Keyboard PC from scratch.

The idea sounds simple: take a normal keyboard and somehow turn it into a fully functional computer. But building a Keyboard PC means fitting an entire PC inside an incredibly limited amount of space.

In this video, I’ll tear apart the keyboard, find the right hardware, and figure out how to fit the motherboard, cooling system, storage, and all the necessary connections inside. Turning this into a Keyboard PC definitely comes with a few unexpected challenges.

After solving the biggest problems, the Keyboard PC finally starts coming together. But there’s still one important question: will everything actually work once the keyboard is closed?

Once the build is finished, I’ll install the operating system and put the Keyboard PC through some real-world tests. I’ll try everyday tasks, watch videos, and even play Minecraft to see whether this tiny computer can actually perform like a normal PC.

The coolest part is that from the outside, it still looks like an ordinary keyboard. But hidden inside is a complete Keyboard PC.

So, can a Keyboard PC really replace a traditional desktop setup?

Watch until the end to see the full transformation and find out how powerful this homemade Keyboard PC really is!
metadata.title: 我把一台完整电脑装进了键盘里｜I Built a PC Inside a Keyboard!
